appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah ! non, non, pas ma sonate ! cria Mme Verdurin... vous êtes bons vous autres, on voit bien que ce n'est pas vous qui garderez le lit huit jours ! » followed by M. Verdurin's immediate concession: « Eh bien ! voyons, c'est entendu... il ne jouera que l'andante. »
appraisal_events.explanation: M. Verdurin proposes a piece and is sharply overruled by his wife's dramatic refusal; he yields at once without argument, showing he defers to her locally.

status_effects.explanation: His suggestion is dismissed by his wife and he immediately capitulates, illustrating his subordinate rhetorical position within the couple in this exchange.
